steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In November 2023, Equity Mates explained that 23andMe sold mail-in DNA testing kits that gave ancestry breakdowns and health insights, framing the core product as simple to use and widely marketed.

episode.title: 23andMe is selling access to customer's DNA

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In November 2023, Equity Mates highlighted the scale of 23andMe’s database, saying only Ancestry.com and the Chinese government rivalled it, implying a data advantage that few could match.

episode.title: 23andMe is selling access to customer's DNA

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In November 2023, Equity Mates discussed 23andMe rolling out a higher-end DNA sequencing product aimed at health risk management, indicating a push to expand its offering beyond ancestry into deeper medical insights.
